intro: Gather everyone around the Marcelli dining table. With ample seating, a spacious top, and strong rubberwood build, it turns every family meal or celebration into a warm experience.

features.title: Minimal yet timeless style
features.text: Clean lines and rich walnut shade make the table versatile, giving your dining area a refined and welcoming feel.

features.title: Sturdy solid rubberwood build
features.text: Crafted with a strong rubberwood understructure, the table gives you dependable durability and support for everyday dining.

features.title: Elegant walnut veneer top
features.text: The MDF top with walnut veneer finish adds warmth and sophistication, blending seamlessly with modern or classic interiors.

features.title: Smooth curved edges for safety
features.text: Rounded edges not only add refinement but also keep dining safe for families with kids, avoiding sharp corners during use.

features.title: Angular legs for more legroom
features.text: Legs are positioned at the ends to give enhanced leg space, so everyone seated enjoys comfort without feeling cramped.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Marcelli 8-Seater Rectangular Solidwood Dining Table
